title: A vision-assisted drone tracked moving pipes in a physical test
summary: In a physical moving-pipe test, a small drone using learned visual label detection and a model-predictive controller recorded 6.73% average tracking error, compared with 15.13% under a standard PID controller. The study compared control methods in a bounded experimental rig.
ai_technology: YOLOv5; learned visual label detection; model predictive control
organization: Northwestern Polytechnical University; Shanghai Jiao Tong University

source_review.scope: v1 learned perception Methods and matched Tello experiments, Table III

evidence.tested: The study used a Tello drone to compare controller behavior in three lab scenarios, with camera-based detection feeding position estimates.
evidence.unknown: This tests the integrated labeled setup under controlled conditions and does not establish field inspection reliability or collision reduction.
evidence.ai_role: YOLOv5 detects visual pipe labels so that both feedback designs can estimate relative position.
